name: io.github.YawLabs/lemonsqueezy-mcp
description: LemonSqueezy MCP server. Manage your store, products, customers, subscriptions, discounts, license keys, webhooks, and more from any MCP-compatible AI assistant. Ships with optional guardrails (store allowlist, refund cap, destructive-call rate limit, parent-filter scoping), audit logging, and an audit-log MCP Resource.
